authorization: The user explicitly requested creation of all fifteen approved concepts and direct upload to the Tiny Tales channel.

upload_policy.release: Only after the individual master passes every automated and manual quality gate.
upload_policy.cadence: Existing safeguarded PT15M task; at most one eligible video per run.

shared_quality_gates: Premium 16:9 scene artwork with consistent character identity, dimensional lighting, depth and exactly one focal action per shot.
No repeated-pose scene swaps, flat UI-like props, misleading objects, generated text, watermarks or obvious template reuse.
Original musical narration with emotional variation; no flat read-aloud and no spoken imitation of sound effects.
Maximum 145 WPM per line, target at or below 140 weighted WPM and at least 0.4 seconds between phrases.
Every lyric, narration phrase and sound effect remains inside the exact scene that visibly supports it.
Frame-accurate BPM plan, phrase-aligned cuts, one climax and a settled resolve.
Continuous visual timeline with zero uncovered or overlapping transition intervals and finale imagery only in the final event.
Full FFmpeg decode, 1920x1080 H.264, 48 kHz stereo AAC and reviewed audio loudness/true peak.
General contact sheet and every-boundary transition contact sheet visually reviewed.
Truthful, content-specific, reviewed 1280x720 custom thumbnail under 2 MB.
Exact immutable channel verification immediately before upload and exact video/title/status read-back afterward.

items.title: Felix Firefly's Night-Light Parade | Pattern Story for Kids
items.visual_system: luminous handcrafted woodland dioramas with leaf lanterns, volumetric moonbeams and practical glowing paths
items.interaction_style: children repeat three safe colour-light patterns to guide woodland friends
items.emotional_arc: uncertain hush to curious confidence to radiant parade
items.motion_language: playful kinetic-soft; firefly light is hero, friends react, foliage remains ambient

items.title: Basil Beaver's Leaky River Workshop | Engineering Story for Kids
items.visual_system: sunlit miniature river valley with tactile wood, stone, reeds, mud and transparent flowing water
items.interaction_style: predict float, sink, block or flow before each real material test
items.emotional_arc: comic problem to careful testing to relieved flowing-river finale
items.motion_language: premium playful; water is continuous support while one material test is hero

items.title: Gus Gecko's Upside-Down Museum | Position Words for Kids
items.visual_system: grand jewel-toned natural-history museum with sculpted exhibits, brass rails and gravity-defying gecko paths
items.interaction_style: point above, below, beside and between as Gus returns physical exhibits
items.emotional_arc: mischievous discovery to focused restoration to elegant gallery reopening
items.motion_language: playful controlled rotations; one camera orientation change per phrase with stable visual anchors

items.title: Nellie Narwhal and the Northern Lights | Colour Adventure for Kids
items.visual_system: cinematic Arctic sea, translucent ice caverns, bioluminescent clues and reflected aurora ribbons
items.interaction_style: trace colour paths and hum rising notes that reconnect the aurora
items.emotional_arc: lonely blue stillness to wonder to sweeping colourful release
items.motion_language: premium calm-soft with slow arcs and one full-colour climax

items.title: Tilly Turtle's Travelling Bakery | Opposites Story for Kids
items.visual_system: stop-motion-inspired coastal bakery cart, cobbled lanes, fabric awnings and tactile bread textures
items.interaction_style: compare warm/cool, soft/crunchy and whole/half during connected deliveries
items.emotional_arc: busy cheerful preparation to one delivery mix-up to shared sunset picnic
items.motion_language: playful rolling match cuts led by the cart wheels

items.title: Pogo Penguin's Wobbly Ice Bridge | Building Story for Kids
items.visual_system: bright Antarctic snow theatre with translucent ice pieces, rope rails and expressive penguin builders
items.interaction_style: choose wide/narrow and stable/wobbly pieces after visible tests
items.emotional_arc: slapstick wobble to thoughtful teamwork to joyful crossing
items.motion_language: kinetic-soft with squash, planted feet and controlled bridge flex

items.title: Zara Zebra's Musical Crossing | Rhythm Story for Kids
items.visual_system: colourful savannah town square where dimensional painted crossing stripes become tuned instruments
items.interaction_style: copy short rhythms and help arrange a safe crossing pattern
items.emotional_arc: noisy confusion to organized rhythm to community street concert
items.motion_language: playful precise; each new stripe owns one beat and one physical sound

items.title: Ollie Otter's Floating Picnic | Balance Story for Kids
items.visual_system: lush storybook river with tactile raft, water reflections, reeds and changing current
items.interaction_style: move one visible picnic item or friend to keep the raft level
items.emotional_arc: carefree launch to tilting suspense to calm shared riverside meal
items.motion_language: premium buoyant arcs with continuous water physics and stable character identity

items.title: Hazel Hedgehog's Lantern Garden | Bedtime Story for Kids
items.visual_system: velvety twilight garden with handcrafted moonflowers, dew, seed lanterns and warm cottage windows
items.interaction_style: breathe, stretch and whisper-sing to help one flower open at a time
items.emotional_arc: restless dusk to tender anticipation to luminous calm
items.motion_language: premium calm-soft; slow unfurling is hero and no frantic ambient motion

items.title: Remy Raccoon's Rainy Roof Band | Sound Story for Kids
items.visual_system: cozy rain-soaked woodland workshop with leaf, wood, metal and umbrella sound stations
items.interaction_style: listen, identify and layer real rain timbres into an original groove
items.emotional_arc: grey-day disappointment to playful discovery to warm indoor-outdoor concert
items.motion_language: rhythmic but restrained; visible raindrop impacts drive every musical layer

items.title: Daisy Dragon's Gentle-Fire Kitchen | Self-Control Story for Kids
items.visual_system: whimsical stone kitchen with copper pans, colourful ingredients and clearly protected cooking stations
items.interaction_style: practise pause-breathe-choose while Daisy controls tiny, medium and stop breaths
items.emotional_arc: excited mistake to patient practice to proud shared meal
items.motion_language: playful controlled; flame is never decorative and appears only at supervised story beats

items.title: Polly Possum's Moonlight Market | Counting Story for Kids
items.visual_system: lantern-lit Australian bush market with tactile stalls, woven baskets and jewel-coloured produce
items.interaction_style: count exact requested items and notice when the basket has enough
items.emotional_arc: bustling curiosity to careful choices to neighbourly supper
items.motion_language: playful market bustle with one transaction as hero per shot

items.title: Sammy Seal's Ice-Paint Symphony | Shapes and Light for Kids
items.visual_system: moonlit snow amphitheatre using non-contact coloured light projections, crystalline mist and reflective ice
items.interaction_style: trace circles, waves and spirals as projected shapes transform with music
items.emotional_arc: blank icy stage to exploratory colour to grand temporary light symphony
items.motion_language: premium flowing match cuts; shapes transform without implying paint or environmental damage

items.title: Mira Meerkat's Shadow Clock | Sun and Time Story for Kids
items.visual_system: warm cinematic desert courtyard changing continuously from sunrise to sunset around one fixed sundial marker
items.interaction_style: point to the sun direction and compare Mira's physically consistent short/long shadow
items.emotional_arc: morning anticipation to midday discovery to sunset celebration
items.motion_language: premium time-lapse restraint; this is explicitly not a silhouette guessing format

items.title: Benny Bilby's Desert Seed Delivery | Nature Story for Kids
items.format_family: Australian desert delivery and germination story-song
items.visual_system: rich red-earth landscapes moving through wind, rain, moonlight and flowering desert with tactile seed parcels
items.interaction_style: shield, carry, press and water seeds through visible story actions
items.emotional_arc: determined journey through weather to quiet waiting to spectacular bloom
items.motion_language: playful cinematic; Benny's physical delivery is hero and the bloom is the one wow moment
